name: reference-proteomes
what: UniProt reference proteomes, taxonomically balanced: Gammaproteobacteria 1 per genus; other bacteria, archaea and mammals 1 per family; other eukaryotes 1 per order; viruses 1 per genus (~5,300 proteomes, ~18 M proteins). FASTA headers are 'accession|taxid'.
attribution: UniProt Consortium. UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase. Nucleic Acids Research (current release).

name: ncbi-taxonomy
what: NCBI Taxonomy dump (nodes, names, merged); cached as taxonomy.tsv on first use.
license: Public domain (NCBI places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data)
attribution: Schoch CL et al. NCBI Taxonomy: a comprehensive update on curation, resources and tools. Database 2020.

name: uniprot-swissprot
what: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot sequences: taxonomy and names of the AlphaFold Swiss-Prot structures.
attribution: UniProt Consortium. UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase. Nucleic Acids Research (current release).

name: alphafold-swissprot
what: AlphaFold DB predicted structures of UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (v6, ~550 k PDB files in one tar); Foldseek database built locally.
attribution: Jumper J et al. Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Nature 2021; Varadi M et al. AlphaFold Protein Structure Database in 2024. Nucleic Acids Research 2024.

name: pfam-a
what: Pfam-A HMMs and their annotation (type, clan): repeat-like families for the repeat filter.
attribution: Mistry J et al. Pfam: The protein families database in 2021. Nucleic Acids Research 2021; Paysan-Lafosse T et al. InterPro in 2022.

name: esmfold_v1
what: ESMFold v1 weights in HuggingFace transformers format (used as published; not mirrored).
attribution: Lin Z et al. Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model. Science 2023.
mirror: none: referenced from the official repository (set HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com where huggingface.co is not reachable)
